posts.title: Opus 4.6’s Simple Reasoning Errors in the Wild
posts.description: I consider myself a sophisticated LLM user. I’m on the max plans of leading LLMs. I have suites of agents that use different skills and build on existing memory. I build verification agents to check its work. I understand the implications of context compaction and make efforts to mitigate the risk. posts.title: The Hinton Intellectual Dynasty
posts.description: This post summarizes the long lineage of intellectuals in Geoffrey Hinton’s family. Hinton (1947-)’s many associations include backpropagation, AlexNet, Turing Award, Google Brain, Sutskever, LeCun, etc. Notable people within four generations: His great-great-grandfather, or father’s father’s mother’s father, was George Boole (1815-1864), the mathematician and logician after whom Boolean logic is named. (LLM critics find it ironic that the current approach is a departure from the Boolean, symbol manipulation-based approach to AI.
